title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q1 2023 vs Q1 2022

attempts.text: Saudi Arabia's point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) experienced a significant increase in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the same quarter in the previous year. The average weekly POS value increased by 10.0% from SAR 10.41 bn in Q1 2022 to SAR 11.45 bn in Q1 2023. This increase was driven by a 10.0% increase in average weekly transactions, which rose from 127.4 million to 157.2 million. The change in average weekly value was positive, with the beverage and food category increasing by 11.1% and restaurants and café increasing by 10.6%. The construction and building materials category decreased by 10.2%, while the furniture category decreased by 7.0%. The largest movers (by size of change) were Beverage and Food and Restaurants & Café, with Beverage and Food increasing by 10.0% and Restaurants & Café increasing by 10.6%. The other category, Other, showed a decrease in average weekly value by 20.9%, with the construction and building materials category decreasing by 10.2% and the furniture category decreasing by 7.0%.

final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 11.45 bn in Q1 2023, up 10.0% from SAR 10.41 bn in Q1 2022. Average weekly transactions were 157.2 million (up 23.4%), and the average ticket was SAR 72.8 (down 10.9%). The largest movements were: Other increased by SAR 317 mn; Beverage and Food increased by SAR 182 mn; Restaurants & Café increased by SAR 155 mn.
